title: GEE PLAYS Gaming Hub
description: A gaming hub that allows users to explore, play, and share their favorite games. It features a user-friendly interface, game recommendations, and social sharing capabilities.

details.problem: The website helps gamers find and play games easily, providing a platform for game discovery and social interaction.
details.solution: Directly access a curated list of games, read reviews, and share experiences with other gamers.
details.learned: Hosting and deploying a web application, and implementing responsive design for various devices. Also handking API and proxy to bypass browser to API server communicatons
details.challenges: Managing game data and ensuring the website remains responsive across different screen sizes. solving this by using media queries and testing on multiple devices. Also  a redirect pretending to be a CORS error solved by turning off Vercel Authentication for the project

title: GeeWifi WiFi Billing system
description: web-based Wi-Fi management and subscription system that allows users to connect to a network, view available internet packages, make payments, and manage their subscriptions through a simple interface

details.problem: Managing Wi-Fi users, internet packages, payments, and subscriptions manually can be inefficient and difficult to manage as the number of users grows.
details.solution: GeeWiFi provides a centralized web-based system for user authentication, internet package selection, payments, and subscription management.
features: User authentication and Wi-Fi access management
Internet package selection and subscription management
details.learned: I learned how to structure a web-based service using separate frontend and backend services, manage user and subscription data, and design a simple user-friendly interface for a real-world networking system.
details.challenges: One of the main challenges was connecting the frontend with different services while keeping authentication, packages, payments, and subscriptions synchronized. I solved this by separating the system into service layers and using a clear data flow between each component.
